hooks.command: git pull origin main --ff-only --quiet 2>/dev/null; REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); PARENT=$(dirname "$REPO"); DRIVE=$(echo "$PARENT" | cut -c2 | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]'); REST=$(echo "$PARENT" | cut -c3- | sed 's|/|-|g'); ENC="${DRIVE}-${REST}"; MEM_DST="$HOME/.claude/projects/$ENC/memory"; [ -d "$REPO/memory" ] && [ -d "$MEM_DST" ] && cp "$REPO/memory/"*.md "$MEM_DST/" 2>/dev/null; true

REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && cd "$REPO" && git add bin/ src/ data/ docs/ .claude/ user-skills/ memory/ CLAUDE.md README.md install-skills.bat install-skills.sh 2>/dev/null; if ! git diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null; then git commit -m "auto: sync $(date +%Y-%m-%d)" && git push origin main; fi
